Appearance

A sophisticated half-elf in his mid-forties. Well-dressed with an air of quiet authority.

What We Know

Owns and operates The Silk Road Tavern in Fairfield. Known as "Silk" by regulars. Runs a respectable establishment popular with merchants and travelers.

First Impressions

Smooth and polished — clearly a man who knows how to handle people and run a business.
